title: SREV-091 Hook trampoline PUSH/RET stub preservation

source_bytes.description: Writable alias for executable detour bytes

push_ret_envelope.description: Existing 32-bit PUSH imm32 / RET detour owned by a third-party hook

replacement_target.description: Sandboxie jump target written into the detected detour

fallback_jump.description: Ordinary 32-bit relative E9 JMP fallback path

cache_coherency.description: Caller-owned executable code mutation and instruction-cache gate

contracts: the existing 32-bit PUSH imm32 / RET envelope is a third-party-owned detour shape
Sandboxie may replace only the PUSH immediate operand in that envelope
Sandboxie must not rewrite that envelope into a relative E9 JMP
ordinary 32-bit non-PUSH/RET hooks still use the existing E9 relative JMP path
64-bit hooks keep the mov-rax / jmp-rax path
code mutation and instruction-cache coherency remain owned by caller hook-install paths such as SREV-058
